claim.claim-text: 2. The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining one or more context records from the repository, further comprises: collecting one or more portions of the one or more context records from one or more external data sources including security information and event management systems, user directory services, or configuration management databases; and obtaining another criteria to validate the one or more context records, wherein the other criteria includes one or more of a source reliability metric or a temporal relevance indicator.

3. The method of claim 1, further comprising: collecting one or more duplicate context records based on content similarity analysis, wherein the one or more duplicate context records include one or more of a redundant context record, overlapped information content, or a repetitive data element; and consolidating the one or more duplicate context records.

4. The method of claim 1, further comprising: obtaining one or more context quality filters to filter the one or more context records based on one or more of a confidence score or a source attribution; and retaining another portion of the one or more context records that passes the one or more context quality filters.

5. The method of claim 1, wherein collecting one or more severity scores for the one or more events, further comprises: obtaining one or more enhanced prompts that include context record summaries and entity relationship mappings, wherein the one or more enhanced prompts include one or more of a threat assessment template, a guidance framework, or an analytical structure; and using the one or more enhanced prompts to train one or more severity assessment models to improve subsequent event classification.

6. The method of claim 1, further comprising: obtaining one or more composite context records based on consolidation of one or more complementary individual context records, wherein the one or more composite context records include one or more of aggregated entity information, combined relationship data, or an overlapping time window.

7. The method of claim 1, further comprising: collecting one or more context provenance records based on one or more of a record creation timestamp or a modification history, wherein the one or more context provenance records include one or more of an origination source, an update sequence, or a verification status; and maintaining an audit trail for the one or more context records using the one or more context provenance records.

8. The method of claim 1, further comprising: obtaining one or more context record utilization patterns based on one or more of an access frequency or an investigation contribution, wherein the one or more context record utilization patterns include one or more of a retrieval frequency metric, an impact score, or a usage trend indicator; and organizing the repository based on the one or more context record utilization patterns.

9. The method of claim 1, further comprising: obtaining one or more repository schemas based on the one or more context records, wherein the one or more repository schemas include one or more of an entity relationship definition, a metadata field specification, or a data type constraint; and organizing the one or more context records according to the one or more repository schemas for retrieval.

10. The method of claim 1, further comprising: collecting one or more context evaluation criteria based on one or more of a temporal relevance measure or a usage frequency pattern, wherein the one or more context evaluation criteria includes one or more of a record age threshold, an access frequency metric, or a relevance degradation indicator; and applying the one or more context record evaluation criteria to identify context records eligible for removal from the repository or archival.

12.
